title: Tử Vi Ngày Mai
shortDescription: AI-powered Vietnamese astrology app, grown to 33,400 users in 6 months.
fullDescription: AI-powered Vietnamese astrology app. I own product and tech end to end: UI/UX, frontend, backend, AI features (chart reading, AI chat guide), MoMo and VietQR payments, and analytics. The backend runs a 12-step Tam Hợp chart engine (14 main stars, minor stars, decade cycles), and LLM readings are cached per birth chart so repeat lookups cost nothing. Built test-first with a 1,300+ test suite and 1,700+ commits in 6 months.
features: Free Tử Vi birth chart drawn as a 12-palace grid
AI-written readings: overview, personality, career, love, decade and yearly cycles, per-palace detail
"Hỏi Thầy" AI chat that knows your chart, with a two-layer safety guard (keyword filter + LLM judge)
MoMo and VietQR payments (pay in the MoMo app or any banking app), Google login, discount codes and time-limited offers
Self-serve KOC affiliate program with commission wallet and payouts
Content hub (palaces, stars, yearly forecasts, I Ching) for SEO
Vietnamese first, English supported

title: BlissDay
shortDescription: AI wedding planner: plan a Vietnamese wedding by chatting, from timeline and budget to guests and vendors.
fullDescription: Plan a Vietnamese wedding just by chatting: timeline, budget, guest list and vendors, with no spreadsheets. I led the build with an AI agent team (PO, Dev, QC). The core is a function-calling LLM agent: I consolidated its 32 tools into 17, made it read a record before changing it, added a three-layer guard so it never claims an action it didn't take, and track quality with a 57-case evaluation set. Monitoring runs on Grafana Cloud with alerts sent to Lark.
features: BlissDay Concierge: a chat agent that builds and edits the whole wedding plan
Onboarding for 6 traditional Vietnamese ceremonies and 6 wedding styles
Budget tracker across 16 categories with deposits and payments
Checklist and guest list management
Vendor directory by category, package and price range, with map lookup
Reminders for milestones, payments, overdue tasks and budget limits via web push, email and in-app
Every action works by chat or by tapping cards, on the same data

title: Steady
shortDescription: Privacy-first iOS habit tracker with on-device insights. No account, no cloud sync, works fully offline. Live on the App Store.
fullDescription: Steady is a privacy-first habit tracker: no account, no cloud sync, no subscription. All habit data stays on the device, and insights (best days, habit correlations, mood trends) are computed locally. Built solo with React Native + Expo, with native Swift widgets and a Live Activity. Shipped v1.0 in about 3 weeks (first commit 7 Mar, App Store 31 Mar 2026) across 16 sprints run with an AI agent team. Monetized with a one-time $4.99 Pro unlock instead of a subscription.
features: Habits scheduled by time, day of week or interval
Heatmap calendar with streaks, completion rates and personal bests
Weekly insights and habit correlations (e.g. "When you exercise, you meditate 90% of the time")
Quick mood journaling after each habit
Interactive home-screen and lock-screen widgets, plus a habit-timer Live Activity
Dark, light and true-black themes with alternate app icons
Free for 3 habits; one-time Pro purchase unlocks unlimited

title: HungPhu Code
shortDescription: A study/clone of Claude Code to understand how AI coding agents work internally
fullDescription: A CLI chat agent inspired by Claude Code that enables autonomous coding assistance through multiple LLM providers with built-in tool calling. Implements the agent loop pattern where the LLM decides which tools to invoke, executes them, and iterates until completing tasks. Supports autonomous file operations, code search, shell execution, and multi-step workflows.
features: Agent loop pattern with autonomous tool calling and multi-step task execution
9 specialized tools: file edit, glob, grep, bash, sub-agent spawning, and more
Multi-provider LLM support with runtime switching (xAI, OpenRouter, DTA Proxy)
Interactive REPL with slash commands and terminal UI with colored output
Autonomous project scaffolding from single natural language prompts
